symptom: `$Line = find $Lines by Model = $Model; … set $Line = $New;` passed `mxcli check` (plain and --references, entity in the script or already in the project) with "Check passed!", then `exec` refused it ("cannot set object variable '$Line'", CE7247 at build) and rolled the whole script back
cause: Two typings of one flow: MDL-SET01 (checkSetOnObjectVariable) types variables from the text via flowObjectTypes.observe, whose ListOperationStmt case hand-listed head/filter/sort/tail and deliberately left out find ("also the String function"); exec's builder types list-operation outputs through listOperationResult, which counts find as one element. check --references does not cover the gap because validateFlowBody leaves every non-association object to MDL-SET01
file: `mdl/executor/flow_object_types.go` (observe now classifies via `listOperationStmtResult`), `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_actions.go` (`listOperationStmtResult`, the AST twin of `listOperationResult`)
insight: The String-find worry was already answered by the guard above the switch: an output is typed only when the INPUT is a known entity list, and the String find's input is a String — so excluding find bought nothing and cost the commonest object producer in data-merging flows. Replace a hand-listed operation set with the classification the build uses, and test agreement directly: run each producer through ValidateMicroflow AND the flow builder (execSetRefusals) and assert they agree, which a per-path test cannot show. The three other flowObjectTypes consumers (system-member rules) now see find/union/intersect/subtract/range outputs too
